The photo shows a plate of stir-fried noodles (chow mein style) with meat and vegetables, estimated at about 350 g. At roughly 1.5 kcal/g that comes to about 520 kcal.

I can't see how much will be left over from a before-eating photo, so I assumed a small amount, about 10%, or 50 kcal. That leaves about 470 kcal eaten.

For the macronutrients of the eaten portion, I assumed about 18 g protein, 60 g carbohydrate and 18 g fat.
